question: How many indigenously developed weapon systems were released by Defence Research and Development Organization (DRDO) in June 2024 to Indian armed forces under the emergency procurement clause?
solution: The correct answer is __**28**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Defence Research and Development Organization (DRDO)** handed over **28 indigenously developed weapon systems** to the Indian Armed Forces in **June 2024** under the emergency procurement clause. • These weapon systems were designed and developed to meet the strategic needs of the **Indian Army, Navy, and Air Force**, focusing on enhancing their combat capabilities. • The emergency procurement clause allows for expedited acquisition of weapon systems, ensuring that the armed forces are equipped to handle immediate threats and operational requirements. • DRDO's initiative aligns with the **Make in India** policy, emphasizing self-reliance in defense production and reducing dependency on foreign imports. • These systems include advanced technologies such as **missiles, electronic warfare systems, radars, and communication systems**, catering to diverse operational needs.
